reviews.text: Super knowledgeable people. Finally have a dog food that doesn't cause itching. Love this place
They have wide range of cookies and also have cakes
So helpful! Took me right where I needed to be! And the cutest store! Thank you so much!!
Always so helpful finding anything you need.  And Harbor is worth the visit - the “house” dog is just as friendly as the owner
Al was super amazing and sweet throughout my entire experience shopping here for a friend's dog! Will definitely be back.
Amazing store. Carla was so sweet and very helpful!! We will definitely come back!!!
Very helpful and extremely knowledgeable about their products and seem to know what is best for your dog !!!

Love Nauti Dog! Have been a customer for 7+ years. Staff has consistently been wonderful, super friendly, knowledgeable, and very helpful.

Great products for those who are super consious about their dogs health and wellbeing! Food, treats, toys, leashes collars. A smaller botique shop but has tons of great stuff.

Options for picky eaters, pups with allergies, frozen raw, quality kibble. Products I can trust.
Greg is so nice!! My dog approves of this store and I love everything here!!! We met a friend today ! Everyone come to this store

Highly recommend! ⭐️

Such a great variety of high quality treats and well made toys, leash etc.
Like genuinely everything in store is from top brands.

They have everything from a bone bar, buffet of treats with samples, to a line of refrigerators with raw meat.

Other toys I used to get at petsmart would only last a few weeks with my large dog, but the ones here last months to years!

Staff here is always so kind and helpful too.
Worth the splurge!
Great place for natural, grain free food options!

Wonderful experience!  Staff are always personable, professional and attentive and offer high quality service and products at reasonable prices.  The care we receive at Nauti Dog Barkery is truly concierge level on all levels.

This is a hidden gem in Dallas for healthy cat food! Yes, cats too! The local delivery option is a life saver and we just love the staff and owner. They have wonderful customer service and high quality goods for dogs and cats.
Lovely store with great selections in food and pet supplies

We absolutely love Nauti Dog. They always remember our dog so he loves to go too. What I appreciate most is their knowledge on food options and overall  pet health - there isn’t a better store around. If you’re looking for a jerky that your dog will never get tired of and is healthy, try any of the store made ones!

We love this little neighborhood pet store! They didn’t carry our poodle’s puppy food at first, but they immediately offered to order it for us—and now they keep it in stock just for our pup. That level of care is so rare and so appreciated. Their selection of toys, treats, and raw food options is fantastic, and everyone here truly knows us (and our dog!) by name. It’s a small business that goes above and beyond, and we’re grateful to have them in our community. Highly recommend!

Great store and love that they have a big variety of products, especially when it comes to the cooked/raw options. I've been coming here for a few years and the owner along with all the staff are super helpful and knowledgeable. My pups love the food we get for them from here.
Great store! Highly recommend

Amazing store! Always stock for the food we give our frenchie.

Great competitive prices too!

THE BEST store for highest quality dog (and cat) food !!! Staff, especially Al, are super knowledgeable and helpful! Wide variety of top brands of frozen, freeze dried, fresh foods, or grain free kibble (or not) plus accessories make this THE place to go to nourish your canine companions 😎❤️ …
GREAT place!!!!
So much fun in here! Friendly staff!
Nautidog is amazing! Wonderful selection of quality goods for my fur baby and the staff is unmatched!! they are always so kind and so helpful

Love this store!  Super cute. Staff is always super helpful.  They give a discount if you’re next door for a groom at PetBar. Selection is excellent, high quality food and treats.  Support local small businesses!! 😍🐶 …
Best place for information about my itchy dog!! So nice and knowledgeable for my baby’s needs!

I’ve been coming here for 5 years now and it’s the only place I’ll get my dog her raw food. The variety is unmatched and the benefits are visible. Great staff and owner that are knowledgeable and helpful
I have 3 dogs that all require different food and treats. Nauti Dog is the best! The team is very knowledgeable and always so helpful. By far the best barkery around!

I believe I met owner today really nice and personable. The store is super cute and colorful so many options that are super good for your dog. The only store I’ve found in Dallas that have great kidney sensitivity semi raw food options and if you’re lucky enough to live within zip code that offers delivery I received my order within hour
Nauti Dog is the best. I wouldn’t trust my dogs with any other food store except for them. Highly recommend!!!!
The best local place in Dallas to get dog food that is actually good for your pup. Love it.

I am SO thrilled that Nauti Dog moved into town. As a holistic nutritionist, I am ingredient obsessed and want the absolute best for my 2 cavaliers.
This place is a godsend. They have incredible products, wonderful staff… and Harbor, the owner’s dog, is SO sweet and goofy. I don’t think I’ve ever enjoyed going to a pet shop as much as I do this spot. It’s warm, friendly… easy to navigate and the best spot for truly superior products, I feel good feeding my little love bugs.

Tiramisu and cake pops for dogs in a place that has the best dog food selection in Dallas?  Yep...

Greg and the staff at Nauti Dog are the most helpful dog nutritional experts I've experienced. They do a thorough job of educating themselves on food and treats they carry.  In the past, we were left to educate ourselves and just buy food at chain stores.  You wouldn't expect a boutique like this to have better pricing than those places, but they do.

We've been clients of Nauti Dog & RAW for almost 10 years, and the changes we've seen in our Golden Retrievers' health and happiness have been unreal.

- No skin issues or allergies
- Consistent weight
- Decreased shedding
- Smaller, less frequent poops
- Last, but not least, living well past life expectancy

In addition to the lowest pricing on high quality dry dog food in Dallas, they have a great selection of toys and treats.

I shop for 2 kinds of dog food and treats here. The employees are always very helpful and really know their inventory. I recommend Nati Dog to anyone who wants high quality food and outstanding service!
Greg and all his staff are amazing. Our dogs love their raw food and Greg’s chicken and beef jerky!
Best pet store in town. Clean. Friendly. Knowledgeable. So very helpful. Quality food. Quality treats. I don’t go anywhere else.

I love this place! They have the raw food and treats my pups like. They are my go-to spot for all my pups food, treats and toys needs. Not only do they carry quality raw food and treats but their staff is also super friendly and helpful! I drive out of my way to go here a few times a month to stock up on goodies for my puppers. Grateful they carry the brands my dogs love!! Thank you to their team!
So many great items and the owners were really helpful and  all of their recommendations  were perfect. My dog loved every single thing we bought there.
We love Nauti Dog and how helpful their staff is!!!  They even deliver!!!
I love the variety of food and treats they offer. They are always concerned about offering products that are good for your dog
We absolutely love this store! All the dog food and treats are high quality!
Great stuff, my dogs love the salmon dry food
Love this store!! The owner is so knowledgeable and super helpful and kind. Always great experience, love the new location!

This was my first time coming in this store and the customer service was amazing! Super sweet and helpful staff! Plus my puppy loved all the samples they had to offer! I love that idea so you can see which treats your dog likes. Will be back soon!
It’s a great place to find healthy treats, snacks, and food for your dog! They had a lot of single ingredient foods and no raw-hide products, great flavors that my dog is going to love!
Awesome little store with high-quality selections and good prices!! And any dog will love the treat sample bar

We had a dog that we raised from a puppy.  She always had terrible tummie issues, seemed restless all the time and constantly scratched.  At one point she had chewed all the hair off of her tail,  The clerk at Nauti Dog recommended Progility multivitamin supplements.  I forgot to mention how picky she is with food but she loved these!!!  The first thing we noticed were her poops were so much healthier looking and easy to pick up.  She stopped itching & her hair grew back.  I know she must have been a much happier dog because she was so peaceful and calm.  Without the guidance from Nauti Dog we never would have known what she needed.
Love this place, carries a lot of amazing quality brands and products

I can’t say enough good things about Nauti Dog Barkery. They truly take a holistic approach to pet health and it shows in everything they do. The staff is more than friendly, and they’re incredibly knowledgeable across so many areas of pet …

Such a cool store! They have a wide range of quality products and the staff is super helpful and genuinely love your pets (even if they haven't even met). My dog loves the freeze dried kibble, pork jerky treats, and turkey necks!

I Don't know what I would do if I didn't find Raw aka Nauti dog. I needed something natural for my dog's joints and they had the perfect product. Great selection for the most natural human grade dog food, Natural treats and a great shopping …
My dog and cat are thriving since I changed to food from RAW
Love that I can find quality raw food for my dogs locally! They have a variety of brands to choose from and pick-up can be as fast as same day.
Been coming here since I moved to Dallas in 2020, so this review is long overdue. Great healthy options & awesome staff!
